_comment: each pinned to a release tag; the fields are those of
scripts/realworld_projects.json. Big suites run a part of their tests,
named in pytest_args. The tags and commands ran in GitHub Actions

projects.name: saleor
projects.pytest_args: saleor/graphql/account/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/attribute/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/channel/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/checkout/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/discount/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/giftcard/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/order/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/page/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/payment/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/product/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/shipping/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/shop/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/warehouse/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/webhook/tests/benchmark saleor/order/tests/benchmark saleor/graphql/product/tests/queries -n 4

projects.name: django-cms
projects.install: uv pip install pytest pytest-django -r test_requirements/django-5.2.txt

projects.name: paperless-ngx
projects.install: sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q unpaper tesseract-ocr ghostscript poppler-utils qpdf && uv sync --frozen --no-default-groups --group testing
projects.pytest_args: src/documents/tests/test_api_app_config.py src/documents/tests/test_api_bulk_edit.py src/documents/tests/test_api_custom_fields.py src/documents/tests/test_api_document_versions.py src/documents/tests/test_api_documents.py src/documents/tests/test_api_filter_by_custom_fields.py src/documents/tests/test_api_objects.py src/documents/tests/test_api_permissions.py src/documents/tests/test_api_profile.py src/documents/tests/test_api_tasks.py src/documents/tests/test_api_trash.py src/documents/tests/test_api_uisettings.py src/documents/tests/test_api_workflows.py src/documents/tests/test_workflows.py -o addopts= -p no:randomly -p no:cacheprovider -n 4

projects.name: tandoor
projects.install: sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q libsasl2-dev libldap2-dev libxmlsec1-dev pkg-config && uv pip install -r requirements.txt

projects.name: django-allauth
projects.install: sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q gettext && uv pip install -e '.[headless,mfa,openid,socialaccount,steam]' 'django~=5.2.0' 'pytest>=8.3.5,<9' pytest-asyncio==1.3.0 'pytest-django>=4.11,<4.13' 'Pillow>=9.0' 'pyyaml>=6.0.2,<7' 'djangorestframework>=3.16,<4' 'django-ninja>=1.3.0,<2' 'psycopg2-binary>=2.9.10,<3' && (cd allauth && python ../manage.py compilemessages)

projects.name: label-studio
projects.install: sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q libldap2-dev libsasl2-dev libxml2-dev libxslt-dev && pipx install 'poetry>=2,<3' && poetry config virtualenvs.create false && poetry install --with test && python core/version.py && uv pip install 'pytest>=8,<9' && uv pip uninstall tavern
projects.pytest_args: tests/data_manager data_manager projects tasks organizations users -p no:cacheprovider -n 4
